svg.title: An annulus-dense curve and its shrinking flow
svg.desc: Twelve and ninety-six excursions of a numerical nonclosed shrinker. Four time slices use the same spatial scale. Orange highlights the same excursion; dashed circles mark the image closure, not additional flow components.

g.text: The same segment at four times
X(s,t) = √(−t) X(s) · same spatial scale in every panel
